title: Lord, let Your glory fall

[Bm7]Our hearts will[Dmaj7/F#] sing that [G]song[Em7]; God, let Your [G]glory [D]come.
You are [D/F#]good, You are good, and Your [G]love endures.
You are [D/F#]good, You are good, and Your [G]love endures.
